answers.rationale: The requirement specifies a 15kV metal-clad switchgear lineup, which matches the description of the CROWN-ARMV product in the catalog.
Protective relays and controls are typically provided as part of relay and protection panels, which aligns with the EP2-RPP product.
The detailed specification of the switchgear, including vacuum circuit breakers, revenue meters, isolation switches, and CTs, matches the capabilities of the CROWN-ARMV product.
The arc-resistant Type 2B requirement aligns with the CROWN-ARMV product, which is described as meeting IEEE C37.20.7 Type 2B.
The equipment building is specified as 'by others,' indicating that this requirement is not for a product from the catalog.
The separate utility cable termination compartment with locking capability matches the accessories provided under CROWN-ACC.
The requirement for ground balls aligns with the CROWN-ACC product, which includes ground balls as part of its accessories.
